business_summary: Hangzhou Landscape Architecture Design Institute Co., Ltd. provides landscape design services in China. The company's landscape design services include preliminary design, scheme design, construction drawing design, construction coordination, and other services, as well as conceptual design. It also offers landscaping engineering general consulting services, such as project design, procurement, construction, etc. The company was formerly known as Hangzhou Garden Design Institute and changed its name to Hangzhou Landscape Architecture Design Institute Co., Ltd. in 2002. Hangzhou Landscape Architecture Design Institute Co., Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Hangzhou Landscape Architecture Design Institute Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 조경 설계 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사의 조경 설계 서비스에는 기본 설계, 계획 설계, 건축 도면 설계, 건설 조정 및 기타 서비스는 물론 개념 설계도 포함됩니다. 또한 프로젝트 설계, 조달, 건설 등과 같은 조경 엔지니어링 일반 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Hangzhou Garden Design Institute로 알려졌으며 2002년에 Hangzhou Landscape Architecture Design Institute Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Hangzhou Landscape Architecture Design Institute Co., Ltd.는 1952년에 설립되었으며 중국 항저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
